title: Quarterly account review
contextText: Quarterly review of all accounts with Hana and Priya. Not recorded.

note.body:
# Quarterly account review

**Date:** May 28
**Attendees:** Alex Rivera (Larkspur Labs), Hana Sato (Larkspur Labs), Priya Raman (Larkspur Labs)

## Summary

Quarterly review of every Larkspur Labs client account, covering revenue, staffing and risk. Alex reports to Hana for account matters, so Hana chaired.

## Accounts

- **Northwind Robotics** — the strongest account this quarter. Northwind account revenue is up 30 percent over plan, driven by the pilot extension to Building 5.
- **Halden Freight** — the migration continues without Ravi; JJ now owns the depot integrations. The southern depots cutover is planned for June.
- **Corvid Health** — designs are signed off and the build is starting at the first walk-in clinic.
- **Solvane Energy** — integration kickoff went well; demo targeted for early July.
- **Gullwing Payments** — the discovery gate is close; Felix wants numbers before the build decision.
- **Varden Insurance** — discovery is under way; Rosa will be out for two weeks in June.

## Decisions

- Larkspur **will not bid on Varden's phase two infrastructure work**; the team lacks the mainframe skills and Hana does not want to subcontract it.
- The hiring freeze is over; Priya can open two engineering reqs.

## Staffing

- Hana becomes a partner at Larkspur Labs from July. The announcement goes out internally next week.
- Priya will be on medical leave for two weeks in July. JJ covers engineering management while she is out.

## Action items

- **Hana Sato** — draft the Q3 staffing plan by June 10, including cover for Priya's leave.
- **Priya Raman** — open two engineering reqs this week.
- **Alex Rivera** — prepare a one-page account health summary for the partner meeting.

## Risks

- Northwind now represents a large share of revenue; Hana wants a second anchor client before the end of the year.
